name: Pulse Music v4.0.0 - Snapchat Creative Kit, Spotify-Style Music Share & Next-Gen Smart Playback
body:
# Pulse Music v4.0.0 - Snapchat Creative Kit, Spotify-Style Music Share & Next-Gen Smart Playback

Official major release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, and **Obtainium**.

---

### 👻 Snapchat Creative Kit Integration
- **Direct Snapchat Stories Sharing**: Tap the Snapchat share icon on any song to launch directly into Snapchat Camera with a rich media sticker and instant deep-link playback URL (`pulsemusic://song?videoId=...`).
- **Interactive Deep Linking**: Tapping shared Pulse stories immediately opens and resumes the track inside Pulse Music on recipient devices.

### 🎨 Spotify-Style 9:16 Music Card Sharing
- **Dynamic Ambient Color Glow**: High-resolution 9:16 vertical cards with album artwork glow that dynamically matches the album color palette.
- **Pulse Audio Soundwave Barcode**: Custom brand-exclusive soundwave barcode with interactive swatches and high-contrast typography.
- **One-Tap Export & Direct Share**: Save card to Gallery, copy playback link, or share directly to system apps and Snapchat.

### ⏭️ Smart Queue & Playback Skipping Fixes
- **No More Replaying on Skip**: User-initiated track skip (`seekToNext()` / `seekToPrevious()`) now properly bypasses single-track repeat (`REPEAT_MODE_ONE`) to always advance to the next song in the queue.
- **100% Pure Radio Discovery**: Discovery ratio is defaulted to 100% fresh recommendations, eliminating repetitive liked song looping during radio playback.
- **History-Preserving Shuffle**: Appending songs to the queue in shuffle mode no longer resets playback history or reshuffles already played songs.
- **Seamless Autoplay & Endless Queue**: Defaulted endless queue to active with automatic fallback to related radio recommendations when playlist ends.
- **Queue Deduplication**: Eliminated duplicate song entries when appending recommendations or loading more catalog items.

### ⚡ Performance & Stability
- **Windows x64 Signed Setup**: Updated installer signed with digital certificates and zero cold-start delay.
- **Android Multi-ABI Support**: Optimized builds for universal, arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, and x86_64 architectures.
